title: PipeShift: research artifact for 'When Data Pipelines Change: A Controlled Evaluation of Silent Errors in LLM-Generated Analytics Code'
description: Benchmark code, 32 primary and 3 exploratory held-out fault scenarios, frozen prompts and configurations, 120 generations (119 generated programs and 120 responses), deterministic validators, episode-level results, tables, figures and reproduction scripts. NYC TLC source data are not redistributed; scripts download them with SHA-256 checks. Model outputs are research data subject to the model providers' terms. Re-execution of archived programs is not fresh model sampling.
notes: Companion to a paper accepted at TrustAI-BD 2026 (IEEE BigData 2026 workshop); proceedings record not yet available.
